title: What is e-Khata
content:
Answer:
e-Khata is the digital property record issued by BBMP for properties in Bengaluru. It digitizes ownership and tax-linked details so records are searchable, verifiable, and easier to update.

title: How to apply for e-Khata online
content:

title: Difference between Draft and Final e-Khata
content:
Answer:
Draft e-Khata is preliminary data from tax/property records and may have incomplete fields. Final e-Khata is verified and legally usable for approvals/transactions after validation and fee payment.

title: Difference between e-Khata and New Khata
content:
Answer:
Regular e-Khata usually refers to migration/verification of existing records in BBMP systems. New Khata is for fresh khata creation (for eligible new/unregistered/changed ownership cases). Required documents and scrutiny can differ.
